Answers recorded from a VU+ Solo2 running VTi 15.0.04 (OWIF 1.5.2) on 2026-10-23,
read-only: OpenWebif's /api/config and /api/config/<section> (18 sections, 356
items; JSON re-indented), the box's /usr/share/enigma2/setup.xml and the three
plugin setup.xml files, all through /file?action=download. See ARCHITECTURE.md,
"OpenWebif features beyond DreamHub's calls" and "Box settings on both boxes".
Values are the box's own; nothing in them is a password or a token.
